findings.description: The requirement applies the 49 ms pin change to every fault detection. SWR-SAFE-011 counts a code 8 report as a detection for the latch rule, while CON-SUP-130 and CON-SUP-137 say a non-latching code 8 report alone does not enter the safe state.
findings.requested_change: Limit the pin-change obligation consistently with the specified exception for a non-latching code 8 report.

findings.description: The requirement calls for the status signal to be driven high when the start-up checks pass and no fault has been detected. A latch retained across a watchdog reset under SWR-SAFE-009 can still be set at that point; SWR-SAFE-007 and SWR-SAFE-010 require the safe state to remain latched until power-on reset.
findings.requested_change: Make the operational status indication conditional on the safe-state latch being clear.

findings.description: The requirement makes software responsible for keeping the signals low from reset by configuring the pins. CON-SUP-132 and SYS-PLAT-002 allocate the interval before software configures the pins to external pull-downs; software cannot configure them from the instant of reset.
findings.requested_change: State the software obligation from the point at which software can configure and drive the pins, and reference the board's reset-state provision for the preceding interval.

findings.description: The report format applies when a fault is detected, but CON-SUP-137 says a code 8 report at start-up is not a fault detection except for the latch count. SWR-RST-003 requires that report without specifying its format, so the code 8 report's required format is unclear.
findings.requested_change: Explicitly apply the fault-report format to the watchdog reset report required by SWR-RST-003.

findings.description: The timestamp is defined as the time of detection since the latest reset, but a code 8 report records a watchdog reset that already occurred and CON-SUP-137 says the report is not a fault detection in the ordinary sense. The timestamp event for that report is therefore unclear.
findings.requested_change: Obtain or reference a product decision defining the timestamp event for a code 8 report and specify it in the requirement.
